# Pepe's Party Rental

> Family-owned party rental company in Stafford, Virginia serving Northern Virginia since 2013. Rents bounce houses, water slides, a mechanical bull, event tents, tables, chairs, and party supplies. Free delivery and professional setup within 25 miles of Stafford on orders of $150 or more, with flat distance fees out to 120 miles.

## Business Information
- [Homepage](https://redesign-sepia.vercel.app/): Full product catalog, pricing, booking, service areas, and reviews
- Phone: (571) 244-5255
- Email: pepespartyr@gmail.com
- Address: 94 Tacketts Mill Rd, Stafford, VA 22556
- Hours: Monday-Sunday, 8:00 AM - 9:30 PM
- Rating: 4.8 stars from 121 Google reviews
- Founded: 2013

## Service Area
Stafford, Fredericksburg, Woodbridge, Manassas, Culpeper, King George, Spotsylvania, Dumfries, Warrenton, Colonial Beach, Northern Virginia, and Prince William County. Free delivery within 25 miles of Stafford, VA on orders of $150 or more. Orders under $150 have a $35 delivery fee. Beyond 25 miles delivery is charged by distance: $35 for 25 to 50 miles, $75 for 50 to 80 miles, $250 for 80 to 120 miles. We do not deliver beyond 120 miles.

## Policies
- No deposit required to book
- Free delivery and setup within 25 miles of Stafford, VA on orders of $150 or more
- Orders under $150 have a $35 delivery fee
- Delivery beyond 25 miles is charged by distance: $35 (25 to 50 mi), $75 (50 to 80 mi), $250 (80 to 120 mi)
- No delivery beyond 120 miles from Stafford, VA
- All-day rental (up to 8 hours)
- Free rescheduling for severe weather
- All equipment professionally cleaned and inspected before each rental
